name: French Dip Roast Beef Sandwich with Au Jus
whyItWorks: Thinly sliced, tender lean roast beef served on a soft French hoagie bun is naturally dairy-free and virtually free of rough fiber. Dipping lightly in warm au jus provides savory moisture without needing irritating condiments.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Order the French dip on a soft plain French roll with au jus on the side. Skip cheese and creamy horseradish sauce.
